## Purpose
Timeline-style card listing education history. It renders each `SanitizedEducation` entry with the date range, degree, specialization and institution, with skeleton rows while loading.

## Key concepts
- `EducationCard` props: `loading` and `educations` (`SanitizedEducation[]`, from [[src-interfaces]]).
- Internal `ListItem` renders one timeline entry; the time label is built as `${from} - ${to}`.
- Two skeleton `ListItem`s are shown while loading, via `skeleton()` from [[src-utils]]. Structurally parallel to [[src-components-certification-card]].
